previousRule: The production release workflow hard-fails on stale bootstrap data, incomplete live probes, preflight requirements and an explicit activation blocker, so even an approved protected release/production HEAD cannot be deployed.
newRule: The two required pull-request checks remain mandatory, while the workflow becomes validation-only and owner-authorised manual Vercel deployment is permitted from the exact protected release/production HEAD; incomplete bootstrap smoke and preflight assets remain advisory until completed.
reason: The unfinished automation bootstrap was creating a permanent deployment deadlock unrelated to application quality. The capability and policy checks remain enforced while deployment returns to the proven protected-branch manual path.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner explicitly instructed that the unfinished release blockage be removed so approved Calibration V2 can be deployed without weakening the required production capability checks.
